summary: Frontend-only regression verification of global typography + 42px control-sizing standardization across the 5 redesigned Super Admin modules (ratings, categories, subcategories, addons, custom_jobs). Logged in via 'Login as Admin' one-click button. NO console/pageerror errors across all tested pages/tabs. Computed font-family on body, headings, inputs and buttons all resolve to Inter on both admin landing and inside each tab, and remains Inter after switching to dark mode (htmlFont = 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif'; body = 'Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif'). Measured computed heights of all visible form controls on each tab: admin form inputs = 42px, admin SearchInput (cat-search, addon-search, cja-search, subcat-search) = 42px, Select triggers (role=combobox) = 42px, textareas min-height = 110px. Zero native <input type=date> elements across all 5 tabs — date pickers are custom popovers. Ratings page KPI cards, star filter pills, search box, review card, Rows selector and pagination all render correctly in both light and dark theme. Theme toggle (data-testid=theme-toggle) switches html.dark on and keeps Inter font + layout intact. Create/Edit/Delete flows were NOT executed in this pass to avoid polluting shared seed data (previous iteration 188 confirmed those still function; only visual CSS tokens changed in this pass, no business-logic change).

design_issues.screen: Sidebar + TopBar (global chrome, NOT part of this standardization request)
issues: Sidebar 'menu-search' input renders at 36px and TopBar 'global-search' input renders at 40px — these are outside the shared ui/input component and were therefore not caught by the 42px standardization. Flagging for awareness only; no action required unless the global chrome is intended to be included.

critical_code_review_comments: Standardization is applied to shared ui/* components and ModuleKit SearchInput (all 42px, textarea 110px, radius consistent). However, two chrome-level inputs still use custom heights: TopBar global-search (40px) and Sidebar menu-search (36px). If the intent was 'entire admin', consider migrating those to the shared Input or giving them an explicit h-[42px]. If they are intentionally compact, no change is needed.
The 'Turn on alerts' bottom-left toast overlay still appears on every tab load (same as iteration 188) — does not obscure anything on 1440x900 but may obscure buttons on narrow viewports.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Typography (Inter) and 42px/110px control sizing confirmed across all 5 admin modules. All data-testids from iteration 188 remain present and functional. Zero native date inputs anywhere. Create/Edit/Delete flows were not re-executed this pass because iteration 188 passed and this change set is CSS-only; retest only those flows if a non-visual change lands later. Only outliers found are TopBar/Sidebar global chrome inputs (40px / 36px), which are outside the shared Input component.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found. Standardization applied correctly to shared ui/input, ui/textarea, ui/button (default), ui/select (SelectTrigger), PremiumSelect/PremiumDatePicker triggers and ModuleKit SearchInput, all measured at the expected 42px / 110px heights.
